results.title: Multi-agent reliability patterns: a pragmatic survey
results.content: Survey of supervisor/worker, peer-review, and gated-handoff patterns for multi-agent system reliability. Covers how OnContextCondition handoffs and guardrails reduce silent failures.

results.title: Contract-based verification for LLM agent workflows
results.content: Static and dynamic contract checking for tool-use agents. Demonstrates how routing, schema, and approval contracts catch failures that LLM-as-judge approaches miss.

results.title: Sandboxed regression testing for AI repair pipelines
results.content: Daytona-backed regression validation for autogenerated patches. Discusses isolation, cost, and false-pass rates across patch synthesizers.
